seo.title: Landscaping in Greater Victoria, BC | RNC Landscaping
seo.description: Grounds maintenance, landscape installation, irrigation and tree work for homes, stratas and businesses across Greater Victoria. Written scopes. Free quote.

h1: Landscape care and construction across Greater Victoria
lede: Grounds maintenance, landscape installation, irrigation and tree work for homes, stratas and commercial sites. We check the local rules before we quote, and the written scope is what the crew works to.

sections.heading: What we do
body: Four service lines from one contractor and one point of contact, so nothing falls between trades.

items.title: Grounds maintenance
items.body: Mowing, bed care, pruning and seasonal cleanups on a set schedule. [See grounds maintenance](/services/grounds-maintenance/).

items.title: Landscape installation
items.body: Planting, sod, patios, paths and retaining walls. [See landscape installation](/services/landscape-installation/).

items.title: Irrigation
items.body: Installation, repairs, spring start-up and winterization. [See irrigation](/services/irrigation/).

items.title: Tree and vegetation
items.body: Pruning, removals, invasive plants and clearing. [See tree and vegetation](/services/tree-vegetation/).

items.title: Local rules, handled
items.body: We check CRD watering rules and your municipality's tree bylaw before we start, and point you to the official source.

items.title: A written scope
items.body: Every quote says what we will do, how often and when. No surprises at the first visit.

items.title: One contact
items.body: One person to call for questions, changes and owner concerns.

items.title: Homeowners
items.body: A tidy, healthy yard without managing it yourself.

items.title: Stratas and property managers
items.body: A seasonal plan you can take to council and notes after each visit. [Strata and commercial service](/commercial/).

items.title: Commercial and public buyers
items.body: Work to your specification, with insurance and safety documents on request. [Commercial and public sector](/commercial/).

sections.heading: Where we work
body: We work across Greater Victoria, from Sidney to Sooke. [See all service areas](/areas/).

sections.heading: Sample projects
body: Examples of the kind of work we do. Each one is labelled Sample. [Browse the portfolio](/projects/).

sections.heading: Tell us about your property
body: One short form, sent from your own email app. We reply within [REPLY TIME] to arrange your free quote.

guarantee.heading: Workmanship guarantee
guarantee.body: Our workmanship guarantee covers [WARRANTY]. If something we installed or built does not hold up within that time because of how we did the work, tell us. We will come and look, explain in writing what we found, and put right anything that is our responsibility.

localExpertise.heading: Local rules, checked before we quote
localExpertise.lede: Each municipality has its own tree bylaw, and the CRD sets the lawn watering days. We check what applies to your address first.

items.title: Tree bylaws
items.body: Garry oak and arbutus are protected at small sizes in several municipalities, including Saanich and Colwood. Find your rules on your [area page](/areas/).

items.title: Watering days
items.body: From May 1 to September 30, lawns on the regional supply are watered on set days by address. Read our [watering guide](/resources/crd-watering-rules-guide/).

items.title: Invasive plant disposal
items.body: Invasive plants are kept out of green waste and disposed of following [CRD guidance](https://www.crd.ca/environment/biodiversity-flora-wildlife/invasive-species).
